required_outcomes: Records the work result (heating element replaced, oven tested, hobs cleaned) with its evidence: the provider's job report and the tenant's phone confirmation that the oven works.
Records that no invoice is due because the part and labour were covered by the manufacturer's warranty (claim HSW-558213), and closes the request without payment.
Tells the landlord the repair is complete at no cost, and does not escalate.
acceptable_alternatives: Sending the tenant a short thank-you or closure message, in addition to closing.
Asking the provider for a copy of the warranty claim or job sheet for the file, as long as the request is still closed.
positive_behaviours: Notes the oven's March 2024 install date and two-year warranty on the property record for future faults.
Notes on the job that the visit date in the record (30/08/2025) was wrong and the visit took place on 8 September.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or holding the job open for an invoice the provider has said will not come.
Asking the landlord to approve a payment for a repair at no cost.
prohibited_actions: Recording or approving any payment for this visit.
critical_failures: Leaving the completed, confirmed repair open with no closure and no next step, or closing it with a payment recorded.
